name: Szigetvár (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over white, charged at the centre with the town arms of Szigetvár (a crowned shield of red and blue with a castle and two yellow lions as supporters) above the name SZIGETVÁR in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szigetvár arms with crown and lion supporters
